description: User provides a project root. Client calls REST, server opens CodeGraph (init or existing), starts file watcher, synthesises HTTP bridge edges. Server broadcasts view_snapshot via WebSocket. Client receives nodes/edges/groups, runs ELK layout, Three.js renders the positioned graph.
label: Project Open to Graph Render

members.note: Opens or initialises CodeGraph. Starts watcher. Runs HTTP bridge analysis.
Synthesises cross-boundary call edges from fetch-to-route matching.
Sends hierarchy_snapshot + view_snapshot to every connected client.
Runs computeView with the client's ViewParams.
Applies filters + grouping to produce ViewResult.
Dispatches to flat or grouped ELK layout. Returns LayoutResult with positioned nodes.
Draws the positioned graph on the WebGL canvas.
